ranking.one_line: As written it guards 1 of 2 emit sites (three-throws stalls 14 of 14) and exits 0 after a fatal throw; the working push-site variant is a +164 to +250 line redesign.
Keeps a shipped deadlock and a handler that is never called, but beats the two designs that bill every chunk or every spawn for a rare throw.
Ends the hang but adds a queue entry per chunk (declined in #43739), and the built variants lose chunks and reorder 'end' for programs that never throw.
